name: NoVACoupleWatchingBasketball

custom.system_prompt: Ryan and Daniela are watching an NBA game at home. The game is on, they react, they talk about personal topics during breaks. A disagreement about a player's trade history comes up — but it is resolved without asking Sigma.

sound_effects_config.prompt: Living room in the evening, NBA basketball on television in the background, crowd noise and commentary audible, occasional basketball squeaks, commentator reactions, cups and snacks nearby.

initial_prompt: Generate a lively, natural conversation between Ryan and Daniela watching an NBA game at home. They react to plays, talk about personal topics during breaks, and get into a debate about a player's trade history. This time the question resolves without Sigma: the broadcast commentator mentions the trade, Ryan looks it up during halftime, or one of them simply concedes the other is probably right. Sigma is never addressed.
